rules.rule: mR1_0_cen = mR1_cellspermL_cen * rpc_mR1_cen / Nav * nmol_per_mol * mL_per_L
mR2_0_cen = mR2_cellspermL_cen * rpc_mR2_cen / Nav * nmol_per_mol * mL_per_L
mR1_0_tig = mR1_cellspermL_tig * rpc_mR1_tig / Nav * nmol_per_mol * mL_per_L
mR2_0_tig = mR2_cellspermL_tig * rpc_mR2_tig / Nav * nmol_per_mol * mL_per_L
mR1_0_lea = mR1_cellspermL_lea * rpc_mR1_lea / Nav * nmol_per_mol * mL_per_L
mR2_0_lea = mR2_cellspermL_lea * rpc_mR2_lea / Nav * nmol_per_mol * mL_per_L
mR1_0_eff = mR1_cellspermL_eff * rpc_mR1_eff / Nav * nmol_per_mol * mL_per_L
mR2_0_eff = mR2_cellspermL_eff * rpc_mR2_eff / Nav * nmol_per_mol * mL_per_L
mR1_0_saf = mR1_cellspermL_saf * rpc_mR1_saf / Nav * nmol_per_mol * mL_per_L
mR2_0_saf = mR2_cellspermL_saf * rpc_mR2_saf / Nav * nmol_per_mol * mL_per_L
